sn22.110:1.5: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti.
sn22.110:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusito katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
